headline: Revolut Service Disruption Hits Irish Customers Amid Cashless Reliability Fears
summary: A service outage at Revolut impacted its 3.4 million users in Ireland, triggering duplicate charges and temporarily blocking customer fund access, reviving scrutiny over the operational resilience of digital-only banking.
why: Revolut is one of Europe's largest fintech banks with tens of millions of retail accounts across the European Union and the UK.

impacts.name: Fintech
impacts.why: Widespread outages and transaction errors draw regulatory examination over platform resiliency and cashless payment infrastructure.
